svg.aria-label: Before: each Slack App ran its own slack-adapter process with its own config file, listen address, state directory, and instance-registry entry, behind an HTTP API. The adapter kept a subscribers.json ledger swept with plect ls, published a mention to each ledger subscriber with plect event publish, and handed unbound mentions to an on_unbound_mention command and an unbound-mentions feed read by the thread resource's query.subscribe. Channels and the thread effect called that HTTP API with curl and a base_url input, and the stream endpoint streamed deltas with chat.startStream, appendStream, and stopStream. After: one operator-declared slack-adapter service holds one Socket Mode client per configured bot and talks to plect over stdio. An allowed mention is published as user.emit to the thread resource, then to the bot resource slack://team/bot with at most one subscriber, then dropped with a log line; core subscriptions deliver it and return the delivered count. Denials reply once per bot, channel, thread, and user. Channels and the thread effect run slack-adapter actions that call the Slack Web API with the declared config and env-file tokens. The status channel sets the working display for a nonempty status event; the stream channel posts one complete reply and then clears it, and posts nothing for a message delta from an old binding except a hint to remove it; an empty status event clears it at turn end; ordinary messages leave it alone. Live delta streaming is deferred.

g.text: #750 Slack adapter: one service for several bots, with mentions routed through core subscriptions
Before · main: one adapter process per Slack App, each with its own HTTP API and subscriber ledger
subscribers.json ledger, swept with plect ls --json
bound thread: plect event publish <session> per ledger row
unbound: on_unbound_mention command, and a feed read by
channels slack, status, stream and effect slack_thread
every workflow binds base_url to its adapter
plect.message_delta chunks; stream state in streams.json
After · #750: one supervised service holds every bot; core subscriptions decide who receives a mention
token values in the private env_file
channels slack, status, stream and effect slack_thread
run slack-adapter message post | status set |
reply post | thread create with --config service.config
core gives these actions the env-file tokens; the bot is
chosen by channel_id; Slack Web API called directly
mention from any bot (app_mention or message event)
the bot's channel and allowed users
appends once per subscribed session and returns the delivered count
while the turn is in progress
one complete plect.message, then clears status
a plect.message_delta posts nothing; logs a hint
clears at turn end, also with no reply
